comment: * KeyChecker is a PKIXCertPathChecker that checks that the * keyCertSign bit is set in the keyUsage extension in an intermediate CA * certificate. It also checks whether the final certificate in a * certification path meets the specified target constraints specified as * a CertSelector in the PKIXParameters passed to the CertPathValidator. * * @since 1.4 * @author Yassir Elley

variables.name: KEY_CERT_SIGN
variables.comment: the index of keyCertSign in the boolean KeyUsage array

methods.name: public void init(boolean forward) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Initializes the internal state of the checker from parameters
     * specified in the constructor

methods.name: public void check(Certificate cert, Collection<String> unresCritExts) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Checks that keyUsage and target constraints are satisfied by
     * the specified certificate.
     *
     * @param cert the Certificate
     * @param unresolvedCritExts the unresolved critical extensions
     * @throws CertPathValidatorException if certificate does not verify

methods.name: static void verifyCAKeyUsage(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Verifies the key usage extension in a CA cert.
     * The key usage extension, if present, must assert the keyCertSign bit.
     * The extended key usage extension is not checked (see CR 4776794 for
     * more information).

methodNames: public void init(boolean forward) throws CertPathValidatorException
